metadata.title: TRIMME — Book your next haircut
metadata.description: Discover nearby barbers and salons and book a real available appointment in seconds.

home.title: Book your next haircut
home.subtitle: Discover shops near you, then choose the service, the barber and a time that is genuinely available.

acceptInvite.subtitle: Create your TRIMME account to finish joining.

adminHome.title: Platform overview
adminHome.body: Operational platform indicators will appear here when the admin dashboard launches.

shopHome.title: Overview
shopHome.body: Today's appointments and your shop's indicators will appear here when the shop dashboard launches.

shopHome.draftBody: Customers will not see your shop until the platform team activates it.

policy.title: Fields the shop edits itself

shopServices.intro: Set your own services, prices and durations. Turning one on shows it on your shop page at once.
